title: Banishes
description: This is a small mod about The Cross and I hope you like it :)
body:
This mod Adds _**The Cross**_, and _The Stick_ from Gtag, **CHEESE**. (how to make the Cross) Make a Wooden Cross out of Planks than a Cross filter to make A Metal Cross and Re Craft it to Make The _**banish_cross**_ (Three Uses). (how to make **CHEESE**) Smelt a milk Bucket (cheese is the main Thing). (How to make _The Stick_) you don't it's a Dev Item. (How to make a RAT sword). Once I met a Kid on a Server in a Mine and he Asked me to make Him a Sword So i Gave Him A Netherite Ingot A Diamond But he Already a Breeze Rod And he Crafted it Little Rat kid. (How to make a _Banished Portal_). Polished Blackstone Bricks, Nostalgia Cross (Normal cross+blackstone Bricks), Enchantment Particled, and Death (:
